name: WaterColor
question_title: Can I drive a golf cart in WaterColor?
answer_short: In WaterColor, street-legal LSVs yes; regular golf carts no. The Walton County Sheriff says golf carts are not permitted on any public road. Registered LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less, but not US 98 or the roads marked red on the sheriff's LSV map.

lsv.notes: Cross US 98 only at a four-way intersection

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in WaterColor?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less, except red roads on the sheriff's map. Cross US 98 only at a four-way intersection. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart on 30A?
faq.a: No. The Walton County Sheriff says golf carts are not legally permitted on any public roadway. Only registered, tagged LSVs may use 30A.

faq.q: Can an LSV drive on 30A itself?
faq.a: Yes. 30A is not red on the sheriff's LSV map, so registered LSVs may use it. US 98 is off limits except to cross at a four-way intersection.

faq.q: Where do I get the LSV safety sticker?
faq.a: The Walton County Sheriff's Office hands it out at its Santa Rosa Beach administration office, 133 Sheriff Drive, weekdays 8 am to 5 pm.
